name: Self-healing Papular Mucinosis

criteria.description: Presence of multiple asymptomatic, flesh-colored to translucent papules primarily on the face, neck, and upper trunk
Histopathological evidence of dermal mucin deposition with fibroblast proliferation
Spontaneous resolution of lesions without treatment within months to a few years
No systemic symptoms or organ involvement

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (clinical papules, histopathology showing mucin deposition, and spontaneous resolution) must be met
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by histopathology and the characteristic self-limiting course

pathognomonic.symptomName: Multiple asymptomatic papular skin lesions with mucinous content
pathognomonic.notes: Typically flesh-colored, translucent papules on face, neck, and upper trunk
searchTerms: multiple small skin bumps with jelly-like content

pathognomonic.symptomName: Spontaneous resolution of papular lesions over months to years
pathognomonic.notes: Lesions resolve without scarring or treatment
searchTerms: skin bumps go away on their own
lesions resolve without treatment over time

common.symptomName: Dermal mucin deposition confirmed by skin biopsy
common.notes: Histopathology shows mucin accumulation with fibroblast proliferation
searchTerms: mucin deposits in skin confirmed by biopsy
gel-like substance found in skin sample
slight skin redness near affected area

common.symptomName: Lesions predominantly localized to face and upper trunk
common.notes: Distribution pattern typical for the disease
searchTerms: lesions mainly on face and upper body
skin bumps localized to face and trunk
papules concentrated on upper torso and face

common.notes: No fever, malaise, or organ involvement

occasional.notes: Mild itching reported in some cases

rare.notes: Very rare; systemic involvement is generally absent
searchTerms: general symptoms from mucin skin disease
body-wide effects related to mucin deposits

imaging: Not typically required; imaging usually normal
other: Skin biopsy showing dermal mucin deposition with Alcian blue staining

differentialDiagnoses.diseaseId: papular mucinosis secondary to systemic diseases

redFlags: Systemic symptoms such as fever, weight loss, or organ dysfunction
Lack of spontaneous resolution beyond 2 years
